claim: Idle Internet PCs form virtual supercomputers
originalWording: Idle Internet PCs form virtual supercomputers

sources.title: How My Predictions Are Faring — Ray Kurzweil

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Internet volunteers pool unused computation into virtual parallel systems reaching the stated approximately 20-petaflop scale.
reference.rationale: Volunteer computing was already real, but the 2010 retrospective’s cited throughput was below the 20-petaflop target. Folding@home’s documented 2020 exascale aggregate easily exceeds that numerical threshold. It remains distributed task throughput, not a single brain emulator.
